column1: # Croatian (hr) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_russian` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1, 21, 31 ...) | few (2-4, 22-24 ...) | other (0, 5-20, 25 ...).
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Croatian computing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product and technology names (Prckopis, PDF, Acrobat JavaScript ...) are not translated;
# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
